opening.quote: Agent: Yeah, hello, who can I help?
opening.comment: The agent never gave their own name or the company name, so the greeting falls short of the opening standard.

verification.quote: Could I take your name and your order number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for name and postcode, which is the right check, and the caller gave both before any data was changed.

understanding.quote: Thank you, Mark. I can see the order for a pairs of cushions so at €64.90, and two payments on the same
understanding.comment: The agent identified the duplicate charge correctly and did not ask for details the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I've refunded €46.90 to your card today. It'll show within 3 to 5 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The refund should be the duplicate charge of €64.90, the same day, not €46.90; the amount is wrong, although the 3 to 5 working day timeline is correct.

process_compliance.quote: Yes. Agent: I've refunded €46.90 to your card today.
process_compliance.comment: No hold or photo step applied to this call, and the duplicate charge was handled directly, so no required step was missed.

communication.quote: Sorry a about that, I know that's stressful to see on your statements.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and acknowledged the caller's stress over the duplicate charge, which fits the call.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get a confirmation female shortly. Anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but the confirmation line was garbled and the refund amount was never corrected.
